description: CredentialStore::check always calls bcrypt::verify even for unknown users, using a precomputed dummy_hash at the same cost factor as the production hashes. The cost is extracted dynamically (make_dummy_hash reads from the entries map), so it automatically tracks production cost as operators rotate bcrypt cost factors. The integration test 'unknown_user_check_takes_bcrypt_time_not_microseconds' validates this timing property. This is a correct and well-implemented defense against username enumeration via timing.
title: good: auth CredentialStore timing-equalization uses precomputed dummy hash at same cost
